class.name: JRPGUnknownCommand
class.brief_description: A command whose code no registered command class has.
class.description: Stands in for a command whose code is unknown (a plugin that was removed, data from a newer version). It keeps the command exactly as it was saved, so saving the list again loses nothing; the interpreter skips it with a warning.

method.name: get_packed
method.description: Returns the command as it was saved.
